scopeLimits: Local registration administration is evidenced, but public anonymous parcel coverage is unverified.
The Yuezhizhu route is identity-authenticated and person/property-specific, so it is outside the safe parcel-source scope.
The general Guangdong service portal is not evidence of an open Taishan parcel feature service.
A route timeout/empty reply, unavailable viewer, or absence of an exact-point hit would not establish citywide absence.
No credentials, private tokens, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe-field request, or TLS certificate exception was used.
This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or adapter admission.
uncertainty: Taishan has a clearly evidenced local registration/cadastral custodian and a citywide identity-authenticated property-information service, but the checked public routes do not expose an anonymous parcel map/API with safe native IDs and geometries. Coverage, CRS, schema, and exact-point parcel availability remain unknown.
